actions.action: Check that the top 2-3 inches of soil are dry before watering, then water
Make sure the pot drains well
Move the plant to consistent bright, indirect light and only introduce direct light gradually
Move the plant away from cold windows, drafts and heater vents
Group plants together to raise humidity
Trim badly damaged leaves at the base
Watch for a new leaf unfurling from the center
If curling worsens or leaves or stems turn mushy, check the roots for rot
If rot signs appear, reduce watering

reason: The answer gives transplant shock as the main cause and names cold windows as an aggravating factor, matching both confirmed causes; the key fix (move away from the cold window and be patient) is present but listed among humidity, watering and light tips; nothing recommended is harmful.
